builds.name: Reference: Critical duel
builds.goal: Reference for Nilah: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A close-range marksman who gains reach and cone attacks after Q, then commits with dashes and an area pull. Crit and allied healing/shielding are integral to her scaling and survival. Compare crit-linked kit benefits and attack reach during Q with a noncrit duel experiment. Do not assume BotRK/Trinity inherits the value of missing crit scaling. Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Nilah: Compare crit-linked kit benefits and attack reach during Q with a noncrit duel experiment. Do not assume BotRK/Trinity inherits the value of missing crit scaling.

Start with the early core (Kraken, then Navori if attack-driven recycling works) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: With a snap of her whip-blade, Nilah damages any enemies she hits in a straight line in her chosen direction. This action extends her attack range for a short duration. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
